mail_review.situation: 土耳其 Netaş（国防/运营商系统集成商，KAP 上市）采购专家 Ender Bulut 2025-10 经 Simon 转给 Alan；2025-12-01 决定以 **STI-488DGGPM-2BT** 作 L2 方案，走完 NDA/ECCN 供应商开户 → 12-23 PO → 12-24 PI 批准 → 2026-01-13 付款（3 台，$545）→ 1 月发货报关；2026-02-26/27 终端客户（车载容器网络）转向 **L3 组播**，Alan 明示 PIM-SM/DM、RIPng/PBR、IP SLA「NOT available with the current chipset」、CENTEC 温度不够，3-02 Ender 留 1 台样机在客户处并「等新 L2 机会」；此后只有 Alan 7-17 单向更新。
mail_review.need: ① 已买：工业 L2+ 8 口 PoE（2×BT）3 台做实验室 + POC；② 真正的项目需求（2026-02-27 原话）：车载容器内多网络整合，2–4 台交换机/车，非核心汇聚，但**必须 L3 + PIM-SM/PIM-DM**，工作温度 **-40~+71 °C**，Netaş 自己做加固外壳；③ 2025-10-17 曾要 Marvell 模组 PCBA 的年量阶梯价（1–10 / 11–25 / 26–…）——说明他们考虑自制整机。
mail_review.breakpoint: 不是价格、不是信任（PO/付款/报关都走完了），是**芯片方案的功能上限 + 温度**。Alan 2026-02-27 原话「PIM-SM/DM, problem; RIPng/PBR, big problem; IP SLA, problem. It is really hard to move on: R&D, ROI etc.」——属于 C10 边界，不设计绕路。但 7.5 固件已补 PIM-SM（仅 CLI、无 PIM-DM、无 IP SLA，见微信 Peter 2026 原话），边界比 2 月时小了一格。

draft_en.subject: Re: vehicle network L3 requirement — PIM-SM now in firmware 7.5
draft_en.body:
Hi, Ender,

In February we had to say "problem" to PIM-SM/DM, RIPng/PBR and IP SLA for the vehicle container network. One of those has moved: PIM-SM is now available in firmware 7.5 (CLI). PIM-DM, RIPng, PBR and IP SLA are still not there, and I will not pretend otherwise.

Temperature: the industrial units are rated -40 to +75 C, so your -40 to +71 C spec is covered; the hardened enclosure stays on your side as discussed.

One question: does your end customer's multicast design actually require PIM-DM, or would PIM-SM be sufficient for the 2-4 switches per vehicle?

Thank you.
Alan
